ISCR and CHAKRA sign pact for clinical research in Maharashtra

The Indian Council for Scientific Research (ISCR) and CHAKRA have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at enhancing clinical research capabilities within Maharashtra. The agreement focuses on strengthening the capacity for clinical research in the state.
